entries.heading: りょう【僚】［漢字項目］
entries.evidence: Actual heading supplies modern リョウ and historical レウ. Sense 1 concerns companions sharing work or a role and lists 同僚; sense 2 concerns officials and lists 官僚 and other compounds.
entries.decision: Support colleague/associate and official senses rather than equating every occurrence with personal friendship. Retain the single frozen on-reading リョウ and empty kun list. Historical orthography and name readings are not additional curated questions.

entries.heading: 僚 / 常用漢字 14画
entries.evidence: The returned section identifies 14 strokes, supplies semantic 字訓 and a 形声 discussion, but several essential historical graphs are embedded gaiji images, not legible character text in the extraction.
entries.decision: Do not turn semantic 字訓 into extra frozen KANJIDIC2 kunyomi or claim to have fully decoded the historical argument. Prefer a labelled modern-shape mnemonic with structure-unclassified in the future draft; no origin or phonetic claim is needed.
entries.limits: No gaiji images inspected. KanjiVG's phonetic annotation is a source annotation, not independent historical verification.

entries.dictionary: Digital Daijisen; 精選版 日本国語大辞典; 普及版 字通
entries.heading: どう‐りょう〔‐レウ〕【同僚】
entries.evidence: Daijisen describes people sharing a workplace, or sharing status or a role. The other returned definitions corroborate workplace/role association. The complete frozen JMdict family 1453580 has one noun sense with coworker, colleague and associate glosses.
entries.decision: Reuse words/同僚.md, primary どうりょう and sourced N3 level. Its existing warning against deriving an absolute equal-rank requirement from 同 is compatible with the workplace branch of these definitions. Add only the missing substantive component link unless a later evidence-based review establishes another necessary change.
entries.limits: Dictionary alternatives do not mean that every hierarchy label is interchangeable. This inspection does not certify every possible context or new example.

entries.dictionary: 精選版 日本国語大辞典
entries.heading: かん‐りょうクヮンレウ【官僚・官寮】
entries.evidence: The returned numbered senses include officials and a grouping especially associated with senior officials; an older same-office association and the 官寮 job-duty spelling are separate senses. Frozen JMdict 1211860 supports 官僚 かんりょう as bureaucrat/government official/bureaucracy.
entries.decision: A short, kana-supplied 官僚 example can illustrate the official sense without authoring another support article or declaring all officials corrupt, senior, or interchangeable with every workmate.
entries.limits: The Daijisen section returned attribution only, so no Daijisen definition is claimed. The 4,200-character response was truncated in later mixed encyclopedic material; only the complete preceding named definition is used. No endorsement of the encyclopedic political analysis.

frozenEvidence.limits: Complete frozen families support their own exact spellings/readings/senses, not unrestricted substitution, frequency rankings, constituent allocation from kana substrings, or etymology.
